rationale: Quality People Student Civil Engineer, Gold Coast.
Must be enrolled in second or third year of a Bachelor of Engineering.
mandatory_unmet: Current enrolment in 2nd/3rd year Bachelor of Engineering
title: Student Civil Engineer
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Are you currently enrolled in the second or third year of a Washington Accord accredited Bachelor of Engineering degree?
Do you hold a current Class C drivers' license?

Do you own a suitable Personal Protective Equipment or PPE
(safety boots, 100% cotton sleeved shirt, 100% cotton long trouser and Hard Hat with brim attachment)?
Are you willing to undertake Criminal History Screening?
Are you willing to relocate for this role?
